subject: A single Saturn planet as a warm golden beige sphere with a few quiet cream cloud bands and one broad pale ring system tilted diagonally, visibly passing behind and in front of the planet
prompt:
Generate ONE new individual sticker in the exact illustrative style of the supplied original desktop sticker references. References are style only, not subjects to copy.
Art direction: hand-painted 2D casual-game illustration with restrained local contrast, warm mid-light colors, thin warm locally colored outlines, simple matte painted volumes, just two or three quiet same-hue shadow patches. Modest detail and small broad paint marks. Soft illustrative volume matching the reference artwork. No shiny 3D toy appearance, deep dark crevices, harsh light, or dense surface texture. Do not anthropomorphize objects.
Entire subject centered and fully visible with clear padding on all sides; a narrow clean white sticker-cut margin follows the silhouette. No scene, floor shadow, text, letters, brand or watermark.
Deliver a PNG with a TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND: empty canvas outside the sticker, actual alpha transparency.
Square canvas, target 512 x 512. Entire sticker visible with clear padding.
SUBJECT: A single Saturn planet as a warm golden beige sphere with a few quiet cream cloud bands and one broad pale ring system tilted diagonally, visibly passing behind and in front of the planet. Draw exactly one isolated planet, scientifically recognizable through its main color, atmospheric or surface pattern, and any inherent ring system. The supplied planet images are style references only; do not copy their planet, markings, palette arrangement or pose. No face, eyes, limbs, stars, moons, orbit lines, glow, space scene or extra objects. Use a simple readable circular silhouette, restrained broad painted detail and quiet same-hue shading. The complete sticker including its narrow clean white cut margin occupies about 78 percent of the canvas in its longest dimension, with comfortable true transparent padding on every side.
note: The initial exact prompt and references above produced v1. The selected master uses the v2 reframe edit below, followed by authorized alpha-only cleanup of the two ring openings and alpha values 1..15. No scripted resizing or RGB repainting was used.

selected_edit.prompt: Edit this Saturn sticker only. Preserve the exact planet design, warm golden beige palette, broad pale rings, atmospheric bands, ring overlap, hand-painted 2D style and narrow white cut margin. Reframe the entire sticker smaller and centered so the complete white cut margin occupies about 78 percent of the square canvas in its longest horizontal dimension, leaving at least 10 percent true transparent padding on both left and right and comfortable padding above and below. Keep both ring openings truly transparent. No face, stars, moons, orbit lines, glow, scene, text or extra objects. Do not crop any part. Target 512 x 512 square canvas; preserve the actual returned size without scripted resizing.

alpha_cleanup.authorization: Persistent user authorization for alpha-only cleanup from 2026-09-15.

steps.purpose: Clear the two enclosed near-white ring openings with tight boxes; RGB and dimensions unchanged.
Remove 86 detached opaque pixels inside the two now-transparent openings; RGB and dimensions unchanged.

steps.rule: Set only alpha values 1..15 to zero
steps.purpose: Remove nearly invisible exterior alpha noise; RGB and dimensions unchanged.
